# Ledger glossary

Words the Ledger team uses, for stories, specs and code.

- **Account**: A customer's ledger account that holds a balance and the entries posted to it.
- **Account number**: The identifier printed on statements, up to 34 characters.
- **Daily limit**: The most an account can send in one day, as an amount in the account's currency.
- **Entry**: One posting of an amount to an account.

| Term | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Transfer | Moving an amount from one account to another inside Forge. |
| Holder name | The name of the person who owns the account, as on their ID. |

### Balance

The amount an account holds after every posted entry.
